root_cause.text: The igc TSN transmit-buffer configuration introduced by `0d58cdc902da` allocated 7 KB per TX queue in `IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN`, which was too large under heavy timestamping load and could trigger TX unit hangs in the Intel I225/I226 TSN TX path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN` in `drivers/net/ethernet/intel/igc/igc_defines.h` from `IGC_TXPB0SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB1SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB2SIZE(7) | IGC_TXPB3SIZE(7)` to `...SIZE(5)` and the commit message explicitly says “The previous 7 KB per queue caused TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping load” and cites `Fixes: 0d58cdc902da ("igc: optimize TX packet buffer utilization for TSN mode")`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Adjust TSN transmit buffer sizing to match the I225/I226 hardware specification.
intent_record.what: The definition of IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN was changed so that TXPB0SIZE, TXPB1SIZE, TXPB2SIZE, and TXPB3SIZE each use a value of 5 instead of 7, and a comment was added indicating the value follows the I225/I226 SW User Manual Section 7.5.4.
intent_record.how: This changes the transmit packet buffer sizing used for TSN mode, reducing the allocated buffer sizes for the four TX packet buffers to match the documented hardware recommendation. At runtime, the TSN configuration will program different buffer partitioning into the device registers, which can correct or improve TSN transmit behavior.

grouping_result.intent: Adjust TSN transmit buffer sizing to match the I225/I226 hardware specification.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly adjusts TSN transmit buffer sizing for I225/I226 hardware, which matches the root cause involving an overly large TSN TX buffer causing hangs under load.

candidates.rationale: This macro defines the TSN transmit-buffer sizing that was later found to be too large for the I225/I226 TSN TX path under heavy timestamping load. It is the pre-fix configuration point for the vulnerable buffer allocation.
This line directly sets the per-queue TSN transmit buffer sizes to 7 KB each, which matches the root cause of the oversized TX buffer configuration that can contribute to TX unit hangs.
This completes the oversized TSN TX buffer configuration by assigning 7 KB to the remaining TX packet buffer, reinforcing the excessive allocation implicated in the hang condition.

vuln_statements.explanation: This macro introduces the TSN transmit-buffer configuration that was later found to allocate too much buffer space for the Intel I225/I226 TSN TX path, contributing to TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping load.
This statement sets three TSN transmit packet buffers to 7 KB each, which is the oversized allocation identified as the root cause of the hang vulnerability.
This completes the TSN transmit-buffer sizing with another 7 KB buffer, finalizing the excessive configuration that could trigger TX unit hangs in the vulnerable TSN transmit path.
